sources.label: Custom Morphe patches on Android.
sources.author: kveld9
patch_list: Stops sites from reading motion sensors to identify you.
Blocks rating popups, review requests and promo dialogs.
Blocks usage analytics, crash uploads and experiment downloads.
Removes sponsored wallpapers, news feed and promo cards.
Applies custom colors to Brave dark mode chrome, defaulting to pure OLED black for battery saving on OLED screens.
Stops Brave from minimizing your tabs in the background.
Deletes unused AR and XR files to shrink the app.
Selects the previous tab in the tab group when closing a tab.
Stops tips, reward promos and marketing notifications.
Skips welcome, search choice and onboarding on fresh installs.
Stops background wakeups and battery drain.
Stops sending page text to the Android capture service.

Hides the recurring default browser, rating and promo prompts.
